title: The shooting in Paris: Sidney Bechet and Mike McKendrick
summary: Compton's account of a quarrel at Bricktop's and the shooting outside the Costa Bar in which he was hit above the knee.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: And everybody was giving them a little donation, so they asked Sid, and he didn't have any change on him. He didn't have any. So Mike McKendrick spoke of them and said, you should have some, if you don't get a hold of some, they'll be begging around here for you. And Sidney didn't like it. They had a big argument, and Mike and the bunch went, left there and went off to a place called Costa Bar. That's where we met, and we met over there. Mike was all in there drinking, in this Costa Bar that particular morning. Sid had evidently gone, see we left Sidney in Brick Tops. Yeah. And Sid evidently had went and got a revolver, when someone got a revolver. Mike had one in his pocket, but didn't nobody know it. Well, you know what, you can't revolve with it. Yeah. In the past, who wants a revolver in the pocket? And anyway, Sidney must have passed, evidently passed Costa Bar, and looked in there for Mike. And they had seen him, cause when they come out, Sid was, it had been hiding just below this bar, in a doorway. When they saw Mike get started out. Mike stepped out on the sidewalk, when we was leaving the bar, we were going on down to the bed. And I stepped out right, I was right behind Mike.

And when I stepped out, that's when the shooting was shot. And I guess the first shot got me, missed Mike, cause he couldn't shoot. And I didn't know I was shot, I didn't feel anything. Hit your knee? Right through the leg, right above the knee. And I didn't feel anything, so I didn't, when I put that right foot, the right foot evidently was in the air when, it was stepping out when I got it. Cause when I put it down, it wouldn't support me. And I found myself hopping on my left leg, and I hopped across the street, braced myself against this automobile, and so I could hop back around, and go back from whence I came. And I hopped back to the constant bar, and then the police came, rest of them both.
Did Mike get there any of them? No. You were the only one that got hit then.
The only one, the only American. Yeah. An English lady named Dolores Gibbons was shot through the right shoulder, and the right lung.
Oh, it must have been serious. It was, it was.

And an old French lady up the street was shot in the neck, glazing blow on the head. No. No. They took me to the hospital, the American hospital out in Nui. And when the trial came up, there was no witnesses against them. My God said they.
Cause they weren't, I didn't go to court cause it wasn't shooting at me.
